items.text: Round 2 decisions have been incorporated into conclusion.md. d1 (section placement): Finding 3 and migration step 6 now specify injection immediately after Team Charter and before Team Responsibilities; Action 1's test list was extended with a prompt-builder integration test asserting this ordering. d2 (draft handling): Finding 5 explicitly cites round 2 d2 and Action 1 continues to require re-audit of each TEAM.md before committing draft values. d3 (dependency command scope): Finding 8 was narrowed to ship agent-membership transitivity only, Action 3 title/description/effort were scoped down, and a new Action 4 was added for the deferred shared-skill-coupling and CLI-ownership edges (each labeled with its own edge kind).

The obsolete limitation about 'rendering order being a judgment call for the implementing agent' was removed because d1 resolves it. A new limitation was added: the v1 transitivity projection is unweighted, which is flagged as follow-up work in Action 4 (edge weighting).

Remaining open items are all deliberate deferrals, not gaps: (a) scenario-debug and scenario-refactor team stubs are intentionally not created per round 1 d1; (b) shared-skill and CLI-ownership edges are deferred to Action 4; (c) edge weighting is deferred to Action 4. None of these block landing v2 schema + transitivity-only dependency command.

Readiness: problem_clarity 3 (question fully answered), scope_defined 3 (schema, trim, dependency command v1 + v2 all bounded), approach_solid 3 (additive migration, per-file schemaVersion, documented prompt-builder pattern, projection over existing graph), testable 3 (Action 1 enumerates 4 concrete test cases; Action 3 enumerates projection tests over a constructed fake graph), risk_awareness 3 (limitations section names every known gap and points each to an action where applicable). Item is ready to move forward.

plan_updates: Finalized conclusion.md to incorporate round 2 answers: tightened Finding 3 and migration step 6 with precise Team Profile placement (d1=A); reiterated draft re-audit requirement in Finding 5 and Action 1 (d2=A); narrowed Finding 8 and Action 3 to agent-membership transitivity only, and added Action 4 to cover shared-skill coupling, CLI-ownership edges, and edge-kind labeling as a follow-up (d3=B). Removed the now-stale placement limitation and replaced it with an unweighted-edge limitation. Added a prompt-builder integration test to Action 1's test list. No new decisions introduced.
